population: 77 existing fixed validation person crops from 56 images
projection: native original-grid argmax then exhaustive lookup; SAM query composition before scoring
other_policy: Known non-target predictions map to0; GT0 remains valid; no model-specific ignore
metrics: global valid-pixel confusion; per-class IoU/P/R/F1; foreground mean over nonzero unions; null for zero denominator

b4.input: RGB576x384, cv2.INTER_AREA, ImageNet normalization; source FASHN official parser

b5.input: Bound AutoImageProcessor512x512, RGB/ImageNet, no label reduction

solider.input: Native SimpleFolderDataset affine572x384; BGR2RGB; model RGB normalization; inverse affine logits; align_cornersTrue; scale1/no flip

sam31.native_output: Text-prompt instance masks, scores and boxes; categorical composition0..4 is a derived output
sam31.input: Native Sam3Processor resolution1008 RGB uint8 resize then float normalization0.5; pretrained detector only
sam31.query_policy: Keep all native processor queries passing threshold; use its returned score including extra presence factor
sam31.overlap: Highest original-grid mask probability times native query score among positive masks; ties smaller classID then earlier query
sam31.source: SAM3.1 source tree bound by hash in run; no CCTV decoder warmstart

limitations: Names do not establish annotation-boundary equivalence
SAM masks may contain other persons inside the crop; GT VOID is shared
Training candidate adapters may differ from native zero-shot routes; report configurations explicitly
